1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The corpus is where the schema's admitted shapes, the model's variables, the appended marker, and the undone marker meet; this check forces every document to answer to all four, so the corpus fixes the file's contents without re-deciding any of them. Its four edges span three cells — two prose parents (natural→code), one specification parent (structured→code) and one artifact parent (code→code) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
